title: The Beast Review
snippet: Samuel L. Jackson brings a mix of badassery and vulnerability to the role of President of the United States in The Beast, director Renny Harlin's a fun throwback to high-concept action movies of the past.

title: Scream’s 30th Anniversary Collector’s Set Includes a Bloody Cordless Phone
snippet: The '90s horror classic Scream is getting a 30th anniversary collector's set that includes the movie in 4K along with detective case files and a bloody cordless phone.

title: The Social Reckoning Review
snippet: Jeremy Strong is captivating as an almost alien-like incarnation of Mark Zuckerberg and a smart and sympathetic Mikey Madison shines as the whistleblower who outed Facebook’s corporate secrets. But filmmaker Aaron Sorkin’s work here proves a mixed bag, delivering a sharp script but bringing it to life with workman-like direction.

title: Could Manchester City be expelled from the Premier League?
snippet: A panel of BBC Sport correspondents explore what sanctions Manchester City could face after being found guilty of all charges related to breaches of Premier League financial rules between the 2009-10 and 2017-18 seasons.

title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
snippet: Kristalina Georgieva warns that the technology lifting growth hopes is also pushing up inflation and yields, just as public debt levels rose.

title: Chart: A look at the S&P 500's remarkable and defiant trip to a new record
snippet: The S&P 500 returned to an intraday record Tuesday as tech gains, easing oil prices and Treasury yields helped stocks overcome months of market shocks.

title: Death Stranding Movie Gets Update as Director Scouts Beautiful Filming Locations in Iceland
snippet: The Death Stranding movie appears to be ramping up to production, as director Michael Sarnoski and cinematographer Pat Scola share a beautiful view from location scouting.

title: How event contract bundles are boosting volume on prediction markets
snippet: Combo contracts are driving volume growth even as they make up a small, albeit consistent, share of transactions.

title: Kalshi, Polymarket trading volumes on some products raise questions amid massive growth
snippet: Unusual trading patterns on Kalshi and Polymarket are drawing scrutiny as experts debate whether reported volumes reflect organic market activity.

title: Goldman: Diesel prices set to stay high through 2027 as refineries struggle to meet demand
snippet: Goldman Sachs says tight refinery capacity could keep diesel prices elevated through 2027, with high margins needed to curb demand and rebuild inventories.

title: House Democrat targets candidate prediction market trades after opponent’s Kalshi penalty
snippet: A new bill bans federal candidates from trading prediction market contracts related to their own elections and would result in a fine if violated.

title: Brazilian stocks jump as Bolsonaro now seen as heavy favorite to win presidency
snippet: The moves come after the first round results of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday. Bolsonaro will face incumbent Lula da Silva in a runoff on Oct. 25.

title: Sports betting is increasingly the norm for Gen Z. Here’s why some financial and mental health experts are worried
snippet: Surveys show Gen Z increasingly views sports bets as a form of investment, and those who gamble too often face mental health risks.

title: Lula or Bolsonaro: Wall Street braces for two wildly different results in Brazil election
snippet: With the first round of Brazil's presidential election taking place Sunday, Wall Street is gearing up with starkly different market predictions.

title: How AI is redefining Wall Street jobs — and boosting demand for this new 'hottest skill' by 1,721%
snippet: Banks are fueling a hiring surge for AI engineers who are good at "agent orchestration" — the ability to coordinate teams of specialized agents.
